priority: Buyer adoption and recovery first; small useful product batches in parallel

phases.focus: Dataset quality and research source records
Evidence retrieval and source refresh workflows
Measurement data in materials, quantum and biology
Repeated-use workflows and partner data integrations
Validated long-tail coverage; replace failed ideas rather than rename them

gates: A distinct task and output; parameters, subject names, formats and aliases do not create new products
Inspected sources with license scope, locators, source hashes, revisions and freshness policies
Bounded input and output schemas; examples and negative, refusal and regression fixtures
Actual response recovery with original authorization; no automatic repayments
Ordinary independent buyer compatibility; no proprietary header knowledge left undocumented
Compute and dependency cost ceilings with a positive stressed contribution margin
Complete paginated listing monitoring plus separate quote, settlement and delivery checks
Deployment, publication and operator indexing each require explicit approval
Before scaling past 211, observe at least three unrelated external integrations and two repeat-use workflows; these are management gates, not forecasts
No claims of organic demand from indexing payments, searches, payer counts or price-only route attribution

firstBatch.title: Catalogue price unit audit
firstBatch.task: Normalize integer payment amounts using chain and contract specific supplied decimals; unknown decimals remain unknown
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Versioned asset metadata and decimal conformance fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No USD peg check, live RPC or payment safety clearance

firstBatch.title: Publication update snapshot
firstBatch.task: Retrieve dated correction and update metadata for a specified research identifier
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Crossref update direction and missing coverage fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No statement that absence of a notice proves a work is unretracted or correct

firstBatch.title: Research data and software links
firstBatch.task: Return inspected metadata relations between one paper and its declared dataset or software records
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: DOI and repository relations with link provenance
firstBatch.boundary: A link does not establish reproducibility or software safety

firstBatch.title: Research funding lineage
firstBatch.task: Resolve declared funder and grant identifiers from publication metadata
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Versioned Crossref and funder metadata coverage
firstBatch.boundary: No completeness, award verification or financial attribution claim

firstBatch.title: Bibliography resolution
firstBatch.task: Resolve a bounded bibliography to dated metadata with exact and ambiguous matches separated
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Identifier normalization and ambiguity-labelled reference fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No forced fuzzy match or full-text redistribution

firstBatch.title: Dataset null pattern audit
firstBatch.task: Count absent fields, explicit nulls and empty strings separately across declared columns
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Versioned missingness semantics and non-imputation fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No missing-at-random inference or automatic imputation

firstBatch.title: Dataset key integrity
firstBatch.task: Check composite keys for completeness and duplicate groups without type coercion
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Exact relational identity and typed-key fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No identity verification or deduplication of people

firstBatch.title: Dataset join loss preview
firstBatch.task: Predict unmatched rows and many-to-many multiplication before joining two bounded tables
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Join cardinality and null-key fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No joined cells, database execution or automatic correction

firstBatch.title: Dataset schema evolution plan
firstBatch.task: Detect declared type, unit, nullability and required-field incompatibilities between table schemas
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Direction-aware schema compatibility fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No semantic equivalence proof or production migration

firstBatch.title: Dataset export roundtrip check
firstBatch.task: Compare tables before and after an export, retaining type, position and field-presence changes
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Lossy export and row-order fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No file parser, automatic repair or private cell disclosure

firstBatch.title: Material curve unit reconciliation
firstBatch.task: Reconcile declared axis units across property curves before combining them
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Reviewed property dimensions and supported conversion conventions
firstBatch.boundary: No extrapolation or qualification approval

firstBatch.title: Material test condition grouping
firstBatch.task: Group declared property observations by comparable temperature, method and specimen conditions
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Condition ontology and non-comparable examples
firstBatch.boundary: No inferred material equivalence

firstBatch.title: Material lot traceability
firstBatch.task: Check declared specimen, lot, process and measurement links for broken traceability
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Revision-bound specimen lineage and evidence manifests
firstBatch.boundary: No counterfeit detection or supplier certification

firstBatch.title: Material property source snapshot
firstBatch.task: Return a small reviewed property record with conditions, source locator, units and revision
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Rights-cleared property records from inspected primary sources
firstBatch.boundary: No universal material constants or design-safety guarantee

firstBatch.title: Material measurement revision changes
firstBatch.task: Show how a versioned property dataset changed in measurements, methods and conditions
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Historical snapshots and structured measurement change fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No cause-of-change inference

firstBatch.title: Research trial status snapshot
firstBatch.task: Return current public registry status and revision dates for a specified trial
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: ClinicalTrials.gov schema, terms, freshness and status-change fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: Research metadata only; no diagnosis, trial recommendation or medical advice

firstBatch.title: Assay endpoint crosswalk
firstBatch.task: Map supported assay endpoint labels to reviewed measurement definitions
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Finite assay ontology with source locators and explicit unknowns
firstBatch.boundary: No wet-lab instructions or clinical equivalence

firstBatch.title: Assay sample label reconciliation
firstBatch.task: Find broken sample identifiers between public assay result tables and metadata
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: De-identified public schema and sample lineage fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No participant identity resolution or sensitive samples

firstBatch.title: Assay unit conversion audit
firstBatch.task: Check supported concentration and response unit changes without merging incompatible assay bases
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Assay-specific conversion conditions and refusal fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No dosing recommendations or inferred biological effects

firstBatch.title: Research correction propagation
firstBatch.task: Identify reviewed research records that depend on a corrected source revision
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Source-to-claim dependency graph and correction lineage
firstBatch.boundary: No automatic retraction or invalidation of dependent conclusions

firstBatch.title: Quantum calibration age report
firstBatch.task: Compare experiment times with declared calibration revisions and caller-defined validity windows
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Provider-specific calibration semantics and historical timestamps
firstBatch.boundary: No hardware-fidelity or freshness guarantee

firstBatch.title: Quantum shot dataset lineage
firstBatch.task: Reconcile circuit, job, count totals and basis declarations across shot datasets
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Versioned shot formats and endian convention fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No hardware attestation or statistical independence proof

firstBatch.title: Quantum hardware configuration snapshot
firstBatch.task: Return one dated public processor configuration under reviewed provider reuse terms
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Allowlisted public configuration acquisition and stale-source handling
firstBatch.boundary: No live availability promise or platform ranking

firstBatch.title: Robot message clock audit
firstBatch.task: Detect declared timestamp reversals, offsets and sampling gaps across message channels
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: Clock domains and bounded multi-stream replay fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No control commands or actual sensor synchronization

firstBatch.title: Robot frame tree consistency
firstBatch.task: Check frame declarations for cycles, missing parents and incompatible coordinate conventions
firstBatch.knowledgeWork: ROS frame conventions and independent geometry fixtures
firstBatch.boundary: No sensor calibration or robot safety approval
